Do not connect the preceding point to only one of the activities, and do not use an exclusive gateway for branches that must all be finished.

When the description states that an activity may optionally be performed (for example, introduced with 'may be'), so it can be skipped after a preceding step: Model an exclusive gateway before the optional activity with one branch that performs it and one bypass branch that skips it.
